pages.text: Kerrigan's Crown: a piece of the zerg suit with a perk of its own — regeneration in any armor, a heart every 2 seconds (faster on creep). With the whole zerg suit it heals twice as fast.
Raynor's Helmet: a piece of the terran suit with heavy plating — 6 armor and 4 toughness instead of 3 and 2, and steadier against knockback.
Artanis's Helmet: a piece of the protoss suit; in the whole suit its shields come back three times faster and twice as soon after a hit.
